questions.question: Discuss the role of halides in the chemical industry.
questions.solution_html:
• Halides find their greatest use in the production of sodium compounds and chlorine. Sylvite
  • and other potassium salts are used in fertilizers, as well as in the manufacture of dyes and
  • soaps. Definition with examples - (3.5 marks) . Large quantities of fluorite are used in
  • metallurgical operations as a flux. Halides are also essential for making plastics such as
  • polyvinyl chloride (PVC) and synthetic rubber. In electronics, halides play an important
  • role in the production of semiconductors and are used in processes like etching and metal
  • coating. They also help control electrochemical reactions and prevent corrosion in various
  • industries. – Uses- (4.5 marks) .
